scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @openbot/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/bridge/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts tests *.ts *.json docs README.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md third-party
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages scripts tests *.ts *.json docs README.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md third-party
